mapper.insert: INSERT INTO users (id, username, display_name, platform_role) VALUES (#{id}, #{username}, #{displayName}, 'user') ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET display_name = EXCLUDED.display_name
INSERT INTO users (id, username, display_name, password_hash, platform_role, status) VALUES (#{id}, #{username}, #{displayName}, #{passwordHash}, #{platformRole}, 'active')
mapper.select: SELECT id, username, display_name, password_hash, platform_role, status, created_at FROM users WHERE lower(username) = #{username}
SELECT id, username, display_name, password_hash, platform_role, status, created_at FROM users WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT registration_enabled FROM platform_settings WHERE id = 'default'
mapper.update: UPDATE platform_settings SET registration_enabled = #{enabled}, updated_at = now() WHERE id = 'default'
mapper.select: SELECT id, username, display_name, platform_role, status, created_at FROM users ORDER BY created_at ASC, id ASC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT m.id, m.organization_id, o.name AS organization_name, o.slug AS organization_slug, m.user_id, m.role, m.status, m.created_at, m.updated_at FROM organization_memberships m JOIN organizations o ON o.id = m.organization_id WHERE m.organization_id = #{organizationId} AND m.user_id = #{userId} AND m.status = 'active'

SELECT m.id, m.organization_id, o.name AS organization_name, o.slug AS organization_slug, m.user_id, m.role, m.status, m.created_at, m.updated_at FROM organization_memberships m JOIN organizations o ON o.id = m.organization_id WHERE m.organization_id = #{organizationId} AND m.user_id = #{userId}

SELECT m.id, m.organization_id, o.name AS organization_name, o.slug AS organization_slug, m.user_id, m.role, m.status, m.created_at, m.updated_at FROM organization_memberships m JOIN organizations o ON o.id = m.organization_id WHERE m.user_id = #{userId} AND m.status = 'active' AND o.status = 'active' ORDER BY o.name ASC, m.id ASC
SELECT id, slug, name, status, default_timezone, data_retention_days, approval_policy, created_at, updated_at FROM organizations WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT count(*)::int FROM organization_memberships WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO organizations (id, slug, name, status, default_timezone, data_retention_days, approval_policy) VALUES (#{id}, #{slug}, #{name}, 'active', #{timezone}, 90, #{policy, typeHandler=com.kross.support.JsonbTypeHandler})
INSERT INTO organization_memberships (id, organization_id, user_id, role, status) VALUES (#{id}, #{organizationId}, #{userId}, #{role}, #{status})
mapper.select: SELECT m.id, m.user_id, u.username, u.display_name, m.role, m.status, m.created_at, m.updated_at, count(*) OVER()::integer AS total FROM organization_memberships m JOIN users u ON u.id = m.user_id WHERE m.organization_id = #{organizationId} AND (#{status}::text IS NULL OR m.status = #{status}) ORDER BY m.created_at DESC, m.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT m.id, m.user_id, u.username, u.display_name, m.role, m.status, m.created_at, m.updated_at, 1 AS total FROM organization_memberships m JOIN users u ON u.id = m.user_id WHERE m.organization_id = #{organizationId} AND m.id = #{id}
SELECT count(*)::int FROM organization_memberships WHERE organization_id = #{organizationId} AND role = 'admin' AND status = 'active' AND (#{excludingId}::text IS NULL OR id <> #{excludingId})

SELECT o.id, o.slug, o.name, o.status, o.created_at, (SELECT count(*)::integer FROM organization_memberships a WHERE a.organization_id = o.id AND a.role = 'admin' AND a.status = 'active') AS admin_count, (SELECT count(*)::integer FROM organization_memberships m WHERE m.organization_id = o.id AND m.status = 'active') AS member_count, count(*) OVER()::integer AS total FROM organizations o WHERE o.status <> 'deleted' ORDER BY o.created_at DESC, o.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT o.id, o.slug, o.name, o.status, o.created_at, (SELECT count(*)::integer FROM organization_memberships a WHERE a.organization_id = o.id AND a.role = 'admin' AND a.status = 'active') AS admin_count, (SELECT count(*)::integer FROM organization_memberships m WHERE m.organization_id = o.id AND m.status = 'active') AS member_count, 1 AS total FROM organizations o WHERE o.id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE organizations SET name = COALESCE(#{name}, name), status = COALESCE(#{status}, status), updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM organization_memberships WHERE organization_id = #{organizationId} AND id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE organizations SET default_timezone = COALESCE(#{timezone}, default_timezone), data_retention_days = CASE WHEN #{setRetention} THEN #{retentionDays} ELSE data_retention_days END, approval_policy = COALESCE(#{policy, typeHandler=com.kross.support.JsonbTypeHandler}, approval_policy), updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT count(*)::integer FROM organization_memberships WHERE organization_id = #{organizationId} AND status = 'active') AS active_members, (SELECT count(*)::integer FROM agents WHERE organization_id = #{organizationId} AND status = 'running') AS running_agents, (SELECT count(*)::integer FROM agents WHERE organization_id = #{organizationId} AND status = 'stopped') AS stopped_agents
